subject: Request: temporary ramp pause with legacy-rate guard — exec authorization needed
messages:
From: Adele Barnes <adele.barnes@hospitech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@hospitech.com, Legal - Hospitech <legal@hospitech.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Request: temporary ramp pause and legacy pricing guard

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from our side — we ran into an unexpected funding timing gap that will force Hospitech to pause customer-facing pilots for ~6-8 weeks. We value Redwood’s performance and want to avoid tearing up the progress we’ve made, but we need two things to move forward quickly:

1) A short-term pause on the ramp schedule (ability to halt billed usage progression for up to 90 days)
2) A guarantee that, if we resume within that window, we keep the currently quoted per-token/embedding rates (i.e., legacy/ grandfathered pricing) rather than reverting to list rates

We’re happy to sign a simple addendum. Procurement and Legal are copied. I attached a short note outlining the ask (Hospitech_Ramp_Request.pdf). Can you escalate for executive sign-off?

Appreciate any help — this is time-sensitive for our finance team.

— Adele
Adele Barnes
Head of Partnerships | Hospitech Systems
adele.barnes@hospitech.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, finance_ops@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary ramp pause and legacy pricing guard

Marissa / Soojin — forwarding Hospitech’s ask. Key points: 90-day pause request, lock-in of current quoted rates if they come back within window, and they want minimal paperwork. Attached: Hospitech_Ramp_Request.pdf.

Questions for deal desk / legal / finance:
- Is 90 days acceptable as a standard operational pause without putting our revenue recognition or committed capacity at risk?
- Can we lock legacy pricing for a returning customer without creating an internal precedent? Any suggested guardrails (caps, pro-rated credits)?
- What approvals do we need (CRO/CEO/Finance)?

Soojin — can you draft a terse addendum language we can present to them? Marissa — recommend run at the deal desk level then escalate to Vivek for executive sign-off if needed.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: finance_ops@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-02T08:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary ramp pause and legacy pricing guard

Karthik / Soojin — draft language below that I think balances commercial risk with the customer ask. I attached a redline with tracked changes (proposal_redline.docx).

Proposed short-form addendum (summary):
- Pause window: up to 90 calendar days from signature of addendum.
- Legacy rate guard: If Hospitech resumes usage within the 90-day window, previously quoted per-unit rates (Document: Pricing Proposal dated 2026-10-14) will remain in effect through the earlier of (a) 12 months from resumption or (b) the end of their current contracted term.
- Downsell protections: If Hospitech reduces committed capacity upon resumption, a stepped-down minimum commitment will be allowed once, with a one-time downsizing fee equal to 10% of remaining committed ARR; subsequent downsells revert to standard pricing.
- Caps: Redwood will cap total cumulative credits or allowances related to the pause to $75k.
- Condition: Addendum must be executed by both parties and will be logged to the deal record; addendum requires Finance acknowledgement to confirm revenue treatment.

Ask: Vivek sign-off is required for the downsell fee/cap terms and any deviation from $75k cap. If approved, Soojin can prepare the DocuSign addendum and SOW patch for signature.

Marissa
VP, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: finance_ops@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-03T16:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary ramp pause and legacy pricing guard

Thanks — I reviewed Marissa’s proposed addendum. Approve with the following executive conditions:

1) Approve a single 90-day pause window; no extensions beyond 90 days without CEO approval.
2) Legacy-rate guard is acceptable only if accompanied by: (a) a one-time downsell fee = 10% of remaining committed ARR (as proposed) and (b) a $75k max credit/allowance cap.
3) Finance must confirm anticipated revenue recognition impact and sign off before DocuSign is sent. finance_ops: please confirm by EOD 12/04.
4) Legal to add an explicit clause preventing the customer from transferring the addendum to related entities without Redwood approval.
5) Require a comms plan: CS to schedule a 30/60/90-day checkpoints and a re-onboarding checklist on resumption. Karthik — please own the external comms and timeline.

If Finance signs off as requested, you have my authorization to execute the addendum and initiate DocuSign flow.

— Vivek
CRO | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Adele Barnes <adele.barnes@hospitech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, finance_ops@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-04T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary ramp pause and legacy pricing guard — approved pending Finance sign-off

Adele — quick update and next steps. Thanks for the clear ask and for looping Procurement / Legal. We reviewed internally; leadership has approved a short-form addendum with the following commercial guardrails: 

• Pause: single pause period up to 90 days from when the addendum is signed.
• Legacy-rate guard: If Hospitech resumes within 90 days, your previously quoted per-token and per-embedding rates will be preserved for up to 12 months after resumption (or until contract end, if earlier).
• Downsell protection: One permitted downsizing on resumption subject to a one-time downsizing fee equal to 10% of remaining committed ARR.
• Caps: Total credits/allowances tied to the pause are capped at $75,000.
• Docs: We will send a DocuSign addendum and an SOW patch. Please note execution is contingent on Finance sign-off (internal) — finance_ops has been asked to confirm by EOD tomorrow.

We’ve prepared the addendum redline and SOW patch; attaching SOW_Hospitech_Addendum_v1.docx and the redline for your review. Once Finance confirms, we’ll send DocuSign and request countersignature.

DocuSign preview: https://docusign.com/embedded/abc123
Deal record: https://app.redwood.com/deals/DEAL-7832

If that all looks good on your side, I’ll move the DocuSign request immediately after finance confirms.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
(650) 555-0124
